scope_note: the per-family and per-micro `accuracy` covers every scorable row of the block (train, validation and test together): it is a label-distribution diagnostic, not a held-out result. The held-out predictive performance is the `test` entry of `per_split`, and for a baseline the `baseline.heldout_test` block, which is fitted on train rows only
scoring_rule: exact match on the lowercased projected scalar, labelled rows only; macro-F1 is unweighted over the classes present in gold or prediction

status_rules.exploratory: shipped and scored, but demoted: too small, holdout too small, or a single observed label (accuracy is null with a reason)
status_rules.invalid: a validity flag makes the family unusable as evaluation evidence: answer_literal_leak, group_overlap, held_out_labels_unseen_in_train, near_duplicate_leak, record_id_overlap, saturated, shared_code, split_composition_drift
status_rules.primary: no validity flag, at least 100 scorable rows, at least 2 observed labels, and no train-only shortcut at or above 0.9 on a holdout of at least 30 rows
status_rules.shortcut_note: a baseline fitted on the held-out rows measures nothing, so only train-fitted baselines count as floors
status_rules.unknown: a family file on disk that no rule covers: fail-closed, never primary
